title: WorkPulse attendance.checked_out v1
description: An attendance record was closed by a check-out. Identifiers and derived scalars only — no notes or times beyond the listed fields (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the record belongs to (UUIDv7 string).

workday.description: Calendar date the record belongs to (the check-in workday — never recomputed).

duration_minutes.description: Whole minutes between check-in and check-out (floor).

late.description: The closed record's immutable lateness flag, set once at check-in. Optional (ADR 0013): pre-extension stored envelopes lack it.

minutes_late.description: Whole minutes past shift start + grace for the closed record; `null` when not late or the shift no longer resolves. Optional (ADR 0013): pre-extension stored envelopes lack it.
